prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2025-11-06, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2025-11-06):
| Current ratio           | 1.32 |
| Retained earnings       | 68,459M |
| Current liabilities     | 12,009M |
| Current assets          | 15,884M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 64,923M |
| Total liabilities       | 57,549M |
| Total assets            | 122,472M |
| EBIT / operating income | 2,702M |
| Revenue                 | 14,969M |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The company shows solid balance sheet strength with a moderate leverage profile (debt to assets around 0.47) and healthy liquidity (current ratio ~1.32). Steady profitability with EBIT margin near 18% supports debt service capacity, though limited information on interest obligations and cash flow stability keeps the rating from being higher than investment grade. Overall, credit risk appears moderate with room for improvement given the available data.

DECISION: BBB+
